summary_en: 900,000 shares (9.3% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-07-08 at ¥1,800/share (closing price 2026-07-07), maximum outlay ¥1.75B. Settlement same day after 08:45 JST execution window closes. Board chair and brother signalled intent to sell holdings.
title_en: Notice of acquisition of treasury shares via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Japan Process Development filed notice on 2026-07-07 of a single-day block buyback via ToSTNeT-3 executed on 2026-07-08. The company will acquire up to 900,000 shares (9.3% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) at ¥1,800 per share (the prior day's closing price), for a maximum outlay of ¥1.75 billion. The order is placed during the 08:45 JST ToSTNeT-3 window on 2026-07-08 and is valid only for that trading session; results will be published after close of that window. The stated purpose is to execute flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions, enhance shareholder returns, and improve capital efficiency. The company noted that board chair Hitoshi Obe and his brother Tsutomu Obe have signalled intent to sell their holdings.
